# Wellbeing Magazine

> > Wellbeing Magazine is a bi-monthly print publication guiding holistic wellness since 2006 through science, nature, and lived experience, featuring The Spiral framework for integrated body, environment, and meaning.

Founded in 2006 and based in Wadhurst, England, Wellbeing Magazine combines expert wellness content with original products like the Spiral Orientation Cards. The publication reaches audiences through print magazines, a podcast series, and digital channels including social media and streaming platforms.
